name: 3S Map (classic)
author: Joakim
description: The dead-reckoning automapper, frozen at its long-proven pre-GMCP state - for 3K-3Kingdoms and any character or world without GMCP (needs the display markers the 'aset' config switches on). Restored 25 Aug: the GMCP mapper (3s-map-gmcp) replaced it on 3Scapes, but 3K speaks only MIP, so this one ships again beside it, id and stores unchanged - old maps load as they were. Automapper: learns rooms as you walk, draws a live HUD map with exit connections between rooms on a woven grid, walks you to any mapped room, detects reckoning drift, stitches per-area maps together at their boundaries (compass or portal, with automatic return links for compass crossings), seeds areas from maps.json, and emits map.room / map.walk.* events other plugins can listen to. Frozen legacy: bugfixes only - new features go to the GMCP mapper.
